post_topic: Graceful failure masking real gaps in agentic systems
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

A left-to-right flow diagram showing an agentic orchestrator routing around a broken downstream agent. Layout flows left to right in three columns.

Left column: one box labeled 'Orchestrator' with a small gear icon.

Center column, top path (the fallback path): a dashed-border box labeled 'Agent Module B' with a red X icon inside and a small label below it reading 'ModuleNotFoundError'. An arrow from Orchestrator points to this box. A second arrow exits this box rightward labeled 'fallback triggered' in amber #F5A623. A small amber callout tag on this arrow reads '"not yet built — pending"'.

Center column, bottom path (the skip path): an arrow bypasses Agent Module B entirely, looping underneath it, labeled 'graceful skip' in blue #5a96ff.

Right column: two boxes stacked vertically. Top box labeled 'System Status Dashboard' showing a green checkmark and text 'All systems operational'. Bottom box labeled 'Observability Counter' with an amber background, showing text 'Fallback fires: 847 times / 90 days — INVESTIGATE'. A bold amber arrow points from the Observability Counter box back toward Agent Module B with label 'silent gap detected'.

Above the entire diagram, a title in navy bold text: 'Graceful Failure ≠ Observability'. Below the title in smaller navy text: 'Every fallback path needs a counter.'

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text "Kelvin Davis" bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
